repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个基于 Claude Code 的本地 AI 求职自动化框架。它帮助用户评估职位发布、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。作者利用该工具成功转型为 AI 工程师。项目支持丹麦市场，但工作流设计通用，易于适配其他地区。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code to automate scraping, tailoring CVs, and writing cover letters.
aiSummary.useCase: 自动化求职申请流程，提升求职效率。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Automate the job search process by using AI to evaluate postings, tailor CVs, and write cover letters.

repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个由 Cloudflare 开发的编码代理技能，用于自动化多阶段安全审计。它通过六个阶段协调代理进行漏洞发现，支持独立验证和结构化输出，旨在生成可验证的机器可读安全报告。
aiSummary.summary_en: An automated security audit skill for coding agents that orchestrates multi-phase vulnerability discovery.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要自动化代码安全审计和漏洞发现的场景，特别是大型代码库的深度安全扫描。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Automate the discovery and verification of security vulnerabilities in codebases using multi-agent orchestration.

repos.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

aiSummary.summary: Orca 是一款 AI 编排器，旨在帮助开发者高效管理多个编码代理。它支持在桌面、移动端和远程运行时运行 Codex、ClaudeCode 等。核心功能包括并行工作树、终端分割、设计模式、GitHub/Linear 集成以及 SSH 远程执行。用户可在统一界面中监控、比较并合并多个 AI 代理的代码结果，显著提升开发效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI orchestrator for managing multiple coding agents with parallel worktrees and terminals.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要并行运行多个 AI 编码代理并对比结果的开发者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Run multiple coding agents side-by-side to compare results and manage codebases efficiently.

repos.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

aiSummary.summary: Ponytail 是一个让 AI 代理像“懒散资深开发”一样思考的技能。它通过重用现有代码和只编写必要逻辑来生成更简洁、更安全的代码。相比之前版本，代码量减少 53%，安全性提升，且能显著降低成本和延迟。它不仅优化代码生成，还提供代码审查功能，确保不遗漏关键的安全性和错误处理。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI skill that optimizes code generation by thinking like a lazy senior developer, reducing size and cost without sacrificing safety.
aiSummary.useCase: 旨在让 AI 代理编写更简洁、安全且高效的代码。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To optimize AI-generated code by minimizing lines and tokens while ensuring security and test coverage.

repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
repos.errorMessage: AI 请求失败 (unknown): "timeout of 45000ms exceeded"

repos.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

aiSummary.summary: Ruflo 是一个专为 Claude Code 和 Codex 打造的智能体执行框架。它支持部署多智能体集群、协调自主工作流，具备自适应记忆、自学习能力、联邦通信及向量 RAG 集成。通过插件或 MCP 协议集成，帮助开发者构建复杂的对话式 AI 系统。
aiSummary.summary_en: An agent harness for Claude Code and Codex enabling multi-player swarms, self-learning memory, and federated workflows.
aiSummary.useCase: 部署智能多智能体集群，构建企业级自主工作流与对话式 AI 系统。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms and coordinate autonomous workflows within Claude Code.

repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

aiSummary.summary: Graphify 是一个将代码库、文档等转换为可查询知识图谱的工具。它利用本地确定性 AST 解析（Tree-sitter）构建图结构，无需向量存储，为 AI 助手提供代码理解能力，通过解释提取和推断的连接来节省 token 并提升开发效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: Local deterministic AST parsing tool to convert codebases into queryable knowledge graphs.
aiSummary.useCase: 将代码库转换为可查询的知识图谱，辅助 AI 编码助手进行代码理解与审查。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Convert codebases into queryable knowledge graphs to improve code quality and agent memory.

aiSummary.summary: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编码代理，提供命令行和桌面应用。它内置了两个代理：build（默认，用于开发）和 plan（只读，用于分析）。支持多种安装方式，覆盖 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source AI coding agent for development and analysis tasks.
aiSummary.useCase: 辅助开发者进行代码编写、分析和自动化任务。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Automate coding workflows and analyze codebases using AI agents.

repos.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个提供完整 AI 代理机构的 GitHub 项目。它包含多个具有独特个性和专业能力的 AI 代理（如前端开发、Reddit 社区专家等）。用户可以通过原生桌面应用或 Shell 脚本，将这些代理一键安装到 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 编码工具中，提升开发效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: A collection of specialized AI agent personalities for coding workflows.
aiSummary.useCase: 为 AI 编码工具安装具有特定角色和个性的 AI 代理，以增强开发工作流。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To install specialized AI agent personalities into coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor.

repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.

aiSummary.summary: Headroom 是一个本地运行的 AI 输入压缩工具，旨在减少 LLM 的 token 使用量。它支持库、代理和 MCP 服务器等多种集成方式，能够智能压缩代码、JSON 和文本，在保持答案不变的前提下，显著降低编码代理和 JSON 处理的 token 消耗，保护数据隐私。
aiSummary.summary_en: Local compression library for LLM agents to reduce token usage while maintaining accuracy.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于 AI 编程代理、智能体及需要优化 LLM token 成本、处理大量代码或 JSON 数据的场景。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Reduce LLM token costs by compressing inputs and outputs locally for coding agents.

repos.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个开源插件仓库，旨在将 Claude 转变为特定角色的专家。它包含生产力、销售、客户支持等领域的插件，支持与多种工具集成。用户可以自定义这些插件以适应公司的工作流程和术语，从而提高团队协作效率和产出质量。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source plugins that customize Claude AI for specific roles and workflows.
aiSummary.useCase: 为知识工作者提供定制化的 Claude 插件，以适应特定团队的工作流程和工具集成。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Customize Claude AI to handle specific job functions and company workflows through modular plugins.

repos.description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个跨平台的 AI 编码工具插件市场，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等多种主流工具。项目包含丰富的插件、代理和技能库（94个插件，202个代理），通过 Markdown 源码实现组件的统一管理和多工具适配。
aiSummary.summary_en: A multi-harness marketplace providing plugins, agents, and skills for various AI coding tools.
aiSummary.useCase: 统一管理多种 AI 编码工具的插件、代理和技能，实现跨平台代码辅助。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Share a single collection of plugins, agents, and skills across multiple AI coding tools.

repos.description: AAS Core is the local, agent-first control plane for complete catalog discovery, agent-owned selection, stack validation, and planning, backed by 2,600+ agentic skills. Includes CLI, local MCP, catalog, plugins, and Workbench.

aiSummary.summary: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个基于 Python 的本地代理控制平面，包含 2700+ 可安装的 SKILL.md 播放书。它帮助 Codex 或 Claude 搜索本地目录，进行代理选择、堆栈验证和规划预览。项目提供 CLI、本地 MCP 和 Workbench，支持可重用指令的发现与管理，旨在为 AI 代理提供完整的技能库和规划能力。
aiSummary.summary_en: A local control plane for discovering and managing 2,700+ AI agent skills and playbooks.
aiSummary.useCase: 为 AI 代理提供本地技能库管理和自动化规划能力，支持可重用指令的发现与验证。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Enables AI agents to discover, select, and validate reusable instructions and playbooks locally.

repos.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets

aiSummary.summary: Kronos 是首个开源的金融蜡烛图基础模型，专为处理金融数据的高噪声特性设计。它采用两阶段框架，利用专用分词器将 OHLCV 数据量化为离散标记，并通过自回归 Transformer 进行预训练。该模型支持多种量化任务，已获 AAAI 2026 接收，提供 mini、small、base 等不同规模模型。
aiSummary.summary_en: Kronos is an open-source foundation model for financial candlesticks trained on data from over 45 global exchanges.
aiSummary.useCase: 金融市场的 K 线预测与量化分析
aiSummary.useCase_en: Forecasting financial market trends using K-line sequences.

repos.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs

aiSummary.summary: vLLM 是一个高性能且内存高效的 LLM 推理和服务引擎。它采用 PagedAttention 技术实现高效的 KV 内存管理，支持连续批处理和 FlashAttention 等优化内核，提供极高的吞吐量。同时支持多种量化方法和 OpenAI 兼容 API，易于部署。
aiSummary.summary_en: A high-performance inference engine for LLMs featuring PagedAttention and continuous batching.
aiSummary.useCase: 高性能 LLM 模型推理与部署
aiSummary.useCase_en: Deploy and serve LLMs efficiently for production applications.
